Across the reported runs on four insertion and industrial assembly benchmarks, including a data center compute tray, the end-to-end system reduces cycle time by 23%-48% and cumulative intervention count by 62%-86% relative to the HIL-SERL baseline. Project website: https://pakt-website.github.io/pakt-website}{https://pakt-website.github.io/pakt-website
tldr: PAKT introduces a physically-aligned kinesthetic teaching framework that uses admittance control and a high-performance control stack to collect RL demonstrations within the robot's kinematic limits, improving cycle time and reducing interventions on industrial assembly tasks.
tldr_zh: PAKT提出了一种物理对齐的动觉示教框架，通过导纳控制和高性能控制栈在机器人运动学限制内收集RL示范，在工业装配任务上缩短了循环时间并减少了干预次数。
summary_zh: 真实世界的强化学习系统在应对接触密集的工业操作需求时仍面临挑战，这些需求包括微米级精度、99%以上的成功率以及达到人类水平的节拍时间。尽管离策略算法可以通过利用示范和干预来提升性能，但一个关键瓶颈在于缺乏一种直观的接口，以便在满足物理系统和策略约束的同时收集此类引导数据。我们提出了PAKT，一个用于强化学习中动觉示教的框架。与遥操作方式不同，PAKT依赖于工业中广泛使用的动觉引导。然而，动觉引导的一个关键弱点是操作者可能使机器人沿其物理上无法复现的轨迹（如速度、加速度、加加速度）运动。通过PAKT，操作者通过阻抗控制引导机器人，该控制将人工施加的力映射为运动。下游参考生成器应用与策略执行期间相同的运动学限制，确保收集的轨迹保持在这些限制之内。为支持该示教接口配备合适的执行层，PAKT增加了一个高性能控制栈，将低频强化学习动作映射为高频力矩指令。该控制栈包含参考生成器和随后的阻抗控制器，其中参考生成器在保持阻抗控制器跟踪性能的同时，改善了接触处理并生成更平滑的策略动作。在四个插装和工业装配基准测试（包括数据中心计算托盘）上的报告运行中，端到端系统相较于HIL-SERL基线将节拍时间缩短了23%-48%，累计干预次数减少了62%-86%。项目网站：https://pakt-website.github.io/pakt-website

title: From Instrument-Mounted Demonstrations to In-Vivo Execution: Learning Bimanual Laparoscopic Appendectomy Without Robot-Collected Demonstrations
summary: Most minimally invasive surgery is still performed with hand-held laparoscopic instruments, and the surgeon's instrument kinematics are lost when the operation ends; only the endoscope video is kept. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that captures this motion in the operating room and uses it to train a surgical robot policy, validated on live animals. We introduce a surgical instrument-state logger that mounts on the shaft of a standard laparoscopic instrument and recovers its pose and jaw state from an inertial sensor, a time-of-flight sensor and a Hall sensor, with no external camera or tracker. A data pipeline measures the latency of every sensor channel against a robot ground truth and aligns the channels before forming observation-action pairs. On these demonstrations we train a diffusion policy with a fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone, selecting its design by closed-loop rollouts in a physics simulator reconstructed from depth maps of an ex-vivo rabbit appendix. The policy is then retrained on 849 in-vivo demonstrations from four live rabbits and deployed on four additional live rabbits with electrosurgery armed. With the surgeon selecting the surgical phase, the policy completed the appendectomy in three of the four animals. The results show that demonstrations recorded from a surgeon's own instruments are sufficient to train, select and deploy a bimanual surgical policy in vivo. The robot serves only as the timing reference for sensor calibration and as the executor, and collects no demonstrations. Both demonstration corpora are released to support future surgical robot learning research.
tldr: This paper introduces a pipeline to learn bimanual laparoscopic appendectomy policies from demonstrations captured via a sensor logger mounted on standard hand-held instruments, without robot-collected demonstrations, and validates it on live rabbits.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种从标准手持器械上的传感器记录仪采集的演示中学习双手腹腔镜阑尾切除策略的流程，无需机器人采集演示，并在活体兔子身上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 大多数微创手术仍使用手持式腹腔镜器械完成，手术结束后，外科医生的器械运动学数据便随之丢失，仅保留内窥镜视频。本文提出了一种端到端流程，可在手术室中捕捉这些运动信息，并将其用于训练手术机器人策略，且已在活体动物上完成验证。我们引入了一种手术器械状态记录器，将其安装在标准腹腔镜器械的器械杆上，通过惯性传感器、飞行时间传感器和霍尔传感器恢复器械的位姿与钳口状态，无需外部摄像头或追踪器。数据处理流程针对机器人真值测量每个传感器通道的延迟，并在形成观测-动作对之前对各通道进行对齐。基于这些示教数据，我们训练了一种采用微调DINOv3骨干网络的扩散策略，并通过在由离体兔阑尾声深图重建的物理仿真器中进行闭环 rollout 来选定其设计。随后，该策略基于来自四只活兔的849个体内示教数据重新训练，并在另外四只活兔上进行了带电外科手术部署。在外科医生选择手术阶段的前提下，该策略在四只动物中的三只上成功完成了阑尾切除术。结果表明，仅凭从外科医生自身器械记录到的示教数据，即可在体内完成双手手术策略的训练、选型与部署。机器人仅作为传感器校准的时间基准和执行器，不参与示教数据采集。两个示教数据集均已发布，以支持未来手术机器人学习研究。

title: IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models
summary: Open robot policies increasingly follow two paradigms: vision-language-action models (VLAs) directly map observations and instructions to actions, whereas world-action models (WAMs) incorporate learned video or world dynamics into policy learning or action generation. Although both target the same manipulation tasks and represent alternative design choices, they are commonly reported under different evaluation protocols, leaving their capability, robustness, language sensitivity, and deployment-cost trade-offs unclear. We present IndustrialVLA-Bench, an evidence-aware evaluation of six released VLA and WAM systems under a unified reporting schema. It separately evaluates clean capability on LIBERO, non-language robustness on LIBERO-Plus, instruction sensitivity on LIBERO-Para, and observed execution cost. Reported task scores aggregate three complete evaluations with distinct random seeds under a fixed checkpoint and inference configuration. Across all six systems, clean LIBERO averages differ by only 1.58 points, whereas robustness and paraphrase summaries span 14.62 and 31.08 points. Restricting every comparison to the three protocol-faithful systems preserves the effect (1.36, 14.62 and 23.10 points), so the diagnostic separation reported here does not depend on the weaker evidence tiers. We additionally report observed inference latency, peak memory, runtime mode, and an evidence status for every system. Protocol-faithful, near-reproduction, and pending-verification entries remain visibly separated; only protocol-faithful entries support strict comparisons. Rather than claiming universal superiority of either paradigm, IndustrialVLA-Bench provides traceable evidence for comparing released robot policies on shared practical criteria. Code and evaluation records are available at https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/IndustrialVLA-Bench.
tldr: This paper introduces IndustrialVLA-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating open robot policy models, specifically comparing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World-Action Models (WAMs) across capabilities, robustness, language sensitivity, and deployment costs on LIBERO variants. It provides traceable, evidence-aware comparisons to clarify trade-offs between these paradigms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 IndustrialVLA-Bench，一个统一基准，用于评估开放的机器人策略模型，特别是比较视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）在 LIBERO 变体上的能力、鲁棒性、语言敏感性和部署成本，并提供可追踪的证据以澄清这些范式之间的权衡。
summary_zh: 开放式机器人策略日益遵循两种范式：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）直接将观测与指令映射为动作，而世界-动作模型（WAM）则将学习到的视频或世界动态融入策略学习或动作生成中。尽管两者面向相同的操作任务，代表着不同的设计选择，但它们通常采用不同的评估协议进行报告，导致其在能力、鲁棒性、语言敏感性以及部署成本权衡方面尚不明确。我们提出IndustrialVLA-Bench，这是一个在统一报告框架下对六个已发布的VLA和WAM系统进行基于证据评估的基准。该基准分别在LIBERO上评估干净环境下的能力，在LIBERO-Plus上评估非语言鲁棒性，在LIBERO-Para上评估指令敏感性，并观测执行成本。所报告的任务分数汇总了在固定检查点和推理配置下使用不同随机种子进行的三次完整评估的结果。在所有六个系统中，干净LIBERO上的平均差异仅为1.58分，而鲁棒性和释义摘要的差异分别达到14.62分和31.08分。将每次比较限定在三个符合协议的系统内，该效应依然存在（分别为1.36分、14.62分和23.10分），因此本文所报告的诊断性区分并不依赖于较弱的证据层级。我们还额外报告了每个系统的观测推理延迟、峰值内存、运行时模式以及证据状态。符合协议、近似复现和待验证条目保持明显区分；仅符合协议的条目支持严格比较。IndustrialVLA-Bench并未声称任一范式具有普遍优越性，而是为在共享实用标准下比较已发布的机器人策略提供了可追溯的证据。代码和评估记录可在https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/IndustrialVLA-Bench获取。

title: HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery
summary: Vision-language-action policies benefit from geometric supervision, but current-frame geometry alone does not explicitly describe the changes associated with manipulation. This design is motivated by the goal of learning an embodiment-agnostic visual interface that can be pretrained across robot and egocentric video before robot-specific action alignment. We introduce Geometry-Change VLA (GC-VLA), which learns to predict multiview future-current geometry-change tokens from current observations. Offline frame pairs define a nominal 0.5-second prediction horizon; future observations are used only to construct training targets. Stage 1 trains a geometry-change vision-language model (GC-VLM). Stage 2 introduces a continuous ActionExpert and aligns it with robot actions while stopping action-flow gradients at the VLM interface. Stage 3 enables these gradients to update the trainable VLM components jointly with the ActionExpert. Stage 4 freezes GC-VLA and applies Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow (GCRF), using a binary intervention router and a single bounded residual velocity policy learned from closed-loop feedback. GC-VLA achieves 95.20% success on LIBERO, and GC-VLA with GCRF achieves 99.55%. Inference uses current observations and the learned GC representation without executing the offline target encoders.
tldr: Introduces GC-VLA, a vision-language-action model that learns from future-current geometry-change tokens for embodiment-agnostic visual pretraining, and GCRF residual flow for closed-loop refinement, achieving 99.55% success on LIBERO.
tldr_zh: 提出GC-VLA，通过预测未来与当前几何变化令牌实现与具身无关的视觉预训练，并结合GCRF残差流闭环优化，在LIBERO上取得99.55%的成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作策略受益于几何监督，但仅依赖当前帧的几何信息无法明确描述与操作相关的变化。该设计旨在学习一种与具身形态无关的视觉接口，该接口可在机器人数据和第一人称视频上进行预训练，随后再进行机器人特定动作的对齐。我们提出几何变化视觉-语言-动作模型（GC-VLA），该模型从当前观测中学习预测多视角未来-当前几何变化标记。离线帧对定义了一个标称0.5秒的预测时间跨度；未来观测仅用于构建训练目标。第一阶段训练几何变化视觉-语言模型（GC-VLM）。第二阶段引入连续动作专家（ActionExpert），并在停止动作流梯度通过VLM接口的条件下将其与机器人动作对齐。第三阶段允许这些梯度与动作专家联合更新可训练的VLM组件。第四阶段冻结GC-VLA，并应用几何条件残差流（GCRF），该模块使用二值干预路由器和从闭环反馈中学得的单一有界残差速度策略。GC-VLA在LIBERO基准上达到了95.20%的成功率，而结合GCRF的GC-VLA达到了99.55%。推理时仅使用当前观测和学得的GC表示，不执行离线的目标编码器。

title: Brace Yourself: Task-Conditioned Environmental Bracing for Forceful Humanoid Manipulation
summary: Forceful manipulation is challenging for humanoid robots because interaction forces can disturb whole-body balance. We introduce the Supporting Hand Strategy (SHS), which enables a humanoid to brace against the environment with one hand while performing forceful manipulation with the other. SHS optimises a task-conditioned support configuration that guides two synchronous reinforcement-learning policies, without human motion data or online whole-body trajectory planning. On a Unitree G1, SHS achieved usable contact forces up to 60 N, compared with a maximum sustained force of 13.5 N without environmental bracing, while substantially improving force tracking over a task-independent support configuration. The same policies generalised to different task regions without retraining. SHS therefore provides a simple mechanism for substantially extending humanoid forceful-manipulation capability.
tldr: This paper introduces the Supporting Hand Strategy (SHS), a task-conditioned environmental bracing method using two synchronous reinforcement learning policies that enables a humanoid robot to perform forceful manipulation with one hand while bracing against the environment with the other, achieving significantly higher usable contact forces on a real Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了支撑手策略（SHS），一种任务条件下的环境支撑方法，通过两个同步强化学习策略让仿人机器人用一只手支撑环境，另一只手进行强力操作，在真实Unitree G1机器人上显著提高了可用的接触力。
summary_zh: 强力操作对人形机器人而言具有挑战性，因为交互力可能干扰全身平衡。我们提出了一种支撑手策略（SHS），使人形机器人能够一只手撑住环境，同时用另一只手执行强力操作。SHS优化了任务条件下的支撑配置，引导两个同步的强化学习策略，无需人类运动数据或在线全身轨迹规划。在Unitree G1上，SHS实现了最高60牛的有效接触力，而无需环境支撑时的最大持续力仅为13.5牛，同时相比任务无关的支撑配置，力跟踪性能显著提升。相同的策略无需重新训练即可泛化到不同的任务区域。因此，SHS提供了一种简单机制，可大幅扩展人形机器人的强力操作能力。

title: REDACT: Robust Perceptive Locomotion under Unseen Visual Corruption
summary: Depth-conditioned locomotion policies have demonstrated impressive agile maneuvers, but can be steered to unpredictable actions when observations are outside their training distribution. Occlusion, invalid returns, sensor noise, and visual distractors can shift deployment observations away from nominal simulated depth. While synthetic sensor augmentation targets specified degradations, it does not by itself define behavior under corruption families omitted from training. To address gaps in training-time coverage, we present REDACT (Retaining Evidence Despite Artifacts for Continued Traversal), a teacher-student framework combining an improved visual encoder architecture, persistent feature masking, and a novel consensus-gating algorithm to retain useful depth information under unmodeled corruption. The gate uses approximate conformal calibration on clean observations alone, requiring no prior knowledge of the corruption type. Trained on clean simulated depth, REDACT retains useful visual information under unseen corruption, supporting higher traversal success than existing parkour baselines. Evaluation of depth augmentation across corruption families further shows that REDACT improves robustness where augmentation coverage is missing. Real-world trials demonstrate zero-shot transfer to structured and forested environments with unfamiliar scene content.
tldr: REDACT introduces a teacher-student framework with improved visual encoders, feature masking, and consensus gating to make depth-conditioned legged locomotion robust to unseen visual corruption, validated on real robots.
tldr_zh: REDACT提出了一种师生框架，通过改进的视觉编码器、特征掩蔽和共识门控，使基于深度的腿部运动对未见过的视觉损坏具有鲁棒性，并在真实机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 基于深度条件的运动策略已展现出令人瞩目的敏捷动作能力，但当观测数据超出其训练分布范围时，可能会被引导至不可预测的行为。遮挡、无效返回、传感器噪声以及视觉干扰物都可能使部署时的观测偏离标称的模拟深度数据。尽管合成传感器增强技术针对特定退化类型进行了优化，但其本身并未定义在训练中未涵盖的损坏类别下的行为策略。为弥补训练阶段覆盖范围的不足，我们提出了REDACT（在伪影存在下保留证据以持续移动）框架，这是一种师生框架，结合了改进的视觉编码器架构、持久特征掩蔽以及新颖的共识门控算法，以在未建模损坏条件下保留有用的深度信息。该门控机制仅利用干净观测数据进行近似共形校准，无需事先了解损坏类型。在干净模拟深度数据上训练的REDACT，能够在未见损坏条件下保留有用的视觉信息，相较于现有跑酷基线方法，实现了更高的穿越成功率。跨损坏类别的深度增强评估进一步表明，REDACT在增强覆盖缺失的情况下显著提升了鲁棒性。实际环境试验证明，该方法能够零样本迁移至具有陌生场景内容的结构化环境和森林环境。

title: Capability-Aware Arbitration for Semantic Intent-Based Shared Control
summary: Shared control often allocates robot authority based on confidence in inferred human intent, assuming reliable autonomous execution. When this assumption fails, high intent confidence can cause over-helping. We present a capability-aware shared-control framework in which a vision-language model (VLM) infers human intent and provides semantic-intent confidence, while a vision-language-action (VLA) policy generates autonomous actions. VLA capability confidence is estimated online from the dispersion and local instability of stochastic action trajectories. We design a nonlinear arbitration policy that combines Bayesian-filtered semantic-intent confidence with VLA capability confidence through a sigmoid mapping to adapt robot authority. Our evaluation combined VLM/VLA confidence assessment with a study involving 12 participants performing pick-and-place and bidirectional stacking under in-distribution and out-of-distribution conditions. The proposed method achieved the highest task success rate (92%), compared with manual teleoperation (83%), intent-only arbitration (44%), and fixed equal-weight blending (10%). It also achieved higher control friendliness and lower authority-weighted disagreement than both shared-control baselines. These results demonstrate the benefit of incorporating VLA capability into authority allocation to mitigate over-helping and improve shared-control performance.
tldr: This paper introduces a capability-aware shared-control framework that uses a VLM for intent inference and a VLA policy for action generation, with a nonlinear arbitration mechanism based on semantic-intent confidence and VLA capability confidence to adapt robot authority. The approach improves task success rates and control friendliness in human-robot shared control compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种能力感知的共享控制框架，利用VLM推断人类意图并通过VLA策略生成自主动作，基于语义意图置信度和VLA能力置信度的非线性仲裁机制自适应调整机器人权限，从而在人类-机器人共享控制中提高任务成功率与控制友好性。
summary_zh: 共享控制通常基于对推断出的人类意图的置信度来分配机器人权限，并假设自主执行是可靠的。当这一假设不成立时，高意图置信度可能导致过度帮助。我们提出了一种能力感知的共享控制框架，其中视觉语言模型（VLM）推断人类意图并提供语义意图置信度，而视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略生成自主动作。VLA能力置信度通过随机动作轨迹的离散性和局部不稳定性在线估计。我们设计了一种非线性仲裁策略，该策略通过Sigmoid映射将贝叶斯滤波后的语义意图置信度与VLA能力置信度相结合，以自适应机器人权限。我们的评估结合了VLM/VLA置信度评估，以及一项涉及12名参与者在分布内和分布外条件下执行抓取放置和双向堆叠任务的研究。所提出的方法达到了最高的任务成功率（92%），相比之下，手动遥操作（83%）、仅基于意图的仲裁（44%）和固定等权融合（10%）的成功率较低。与两种共享控制基线相比，该方法还实现了更高的控制友好性和更低的权限加权分歧。这些结果表明，将VLA能力纳入权限分配有助于缓解过度帮助并提升共享控制性能。

title: HOTICE: Whole-Body Humanoid Object Transportation in Cluttered Environments
summary: Object transportation is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots operating in real-world, human-centric environments, yet existing methods struggle when clutter constrains free space around both the robot and its carried payload. We present HOTICE, a whole-body humanoid learning framework for transporting objects through such cluttered environments. First, we introduce Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields, which jointly encode collision-avoidance guidance for the robot and the carried object, enabling coordinated, obstacle-aware motion for both. Second, to address the large action space inherent to whole-body loco-manipulation, we design a dual-agent reinforcement learning architecture that decouples upper- and lower-body control while preserving whole-body coordination via shared state observations and rewards. To train a policy that generalizes across diverse cluttered scenes, we further employ a specialist-to-generalist distillation strategy, in which privileged teacher policies are distilled into a single deployable student policy. We evaluate HOTICE in MuJoCo simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating effective and robust object transportation across cluttered scenarios for objects of varying shapes. Our results show that HOTICE reliably coordinates whole-body motion and object-aware collision avoidance, generalizing effectively to previously unseen cluttered environments while achieving strong performance in sim2real deployment.
tldr: HOTICE presents a whole-body humanoid learning framework for transporting objects in cluttered environments, using decoupled potential fields for obstacle avoidance, a dual-agent RL architecture for whole-body coordination, and specialist-to-generalist distillation for robust sim-to-real deployment.
tldr_zh: HOTICE提出了一个全身人形机器人在杂乱环境中搬运物体的学习框架，利用解耦势场进行避障、双智能体强化学习架构实现全身协调，并通过专家到通才的蒸馏策略实现鲁棒的仿真到现实部署。
summary_zh: 物体搬运是人形机器人在真实人类中心环境中运行的基本能力，然而当杂乱环境限制了机器人及其所携带负载周围的可操作空间时，现有方法往往难以应对。我们提出了HOTICE，一种用于在杂乱环境中搬运物体的全身人形机器人学习框架。首先，我们引入了人形-物体解耦势场，该势场联合编码了机器人及其所携带物体的避碰引导信息，从而实现两者协调一致的、具有障碍物感知能力的运动。其次，为应对全身移动操作固有的高维动作空间问题，我们设计了一种双智能体强化学习架构，该架构在解耦上半身和下半身控制的同时，通过共享状态观测和奖励保持全身协调。为了训练能够在多种杂乱场景中泛化的策略，我们进一步采用了从专家到通才的蒸馏策略，将特权教师策略蒸馏为单一可部署的学生策略。我们在MuJoCo仿真环境和真实宇树G1人形机器人上对HOTICE进行了评估，证明了其在多种杂乱场景下对不同形状物体搬运任务的有效性和鲁棒性。实验结果表明，HOTICE能够可靠地协调全身运动与物体感知避碰，有效泛化至未见过的杂乱环境，并在仿真到现实部署中取得了优异性能。

title: Learning from Humans for Proactive Assistance in Human-Robot Collaborative Transport
summary: We focus on human-robot collaborative transport, a challenging task of broad relevance spanning logistics, manufacturing, and the home, in which a user and a robot work together to relocate a large or heavy object. To act as an effective partner, the robot should reduce the user's effort by contributing to efficient relocation of the object while remaining physically responsive to them. Prior work often addresses these capabilities separately, producing robots that may move the object efficiently but resist user input, or accommodate the user but depend on continuous guidance. Our key insight is that obstacle-constrained collaborative transport requires integrating predictions of human collaborative behavior with compliant robot control. To this end, we introduce PROACT, a framework for human-robot collaborative transport that incorporates anticipation into compliant whole-body control through a learned model of human collaborative behavior. Trained on a large-scale, real-world dataset of dyadic human transport demonstrations, our transformer architecture distills collaborative behavior into predictions of future object motion. Across 108 real-world trials with a 9-DoF mobile manipulator, PROACT reduces mean interaction work by 59.2\% and 20.4\%, and mean completion time by 12.9\% and 6.9\%, relative to compliance-only and MPC baselines, respectively. Footage from our experiments can be found at https://youtu.be/qAGvQfVPjbk.
tldr: This paper introduces PROACT, a framework for human-robot collaborative transport that integrates a learned transformer-based predictor of human behavior into compliant whole-body control, reducing user effort and completion time in real-world trials with a mobile manipulator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PROACT框架，用于人机协作搬运，通过学习人类行为的Transformer预测模型并结合柔顺全身控制，在真实移动操作手上减少了用户努力和完成时间。
summary_zh: 我们聚焦于人机协作搬运任务，这是一项具有广泛应用前景的挑战性任务，涉及物流、制造业及家庭场景，其中用户与机器人共同协作以移动大型或重型物体。为成为高效的合作者，机器人应通过促进物体的高效搬运来减轻用户的体力负担，同时保持对用户的身体响应性。以往的研究往往分别处理这些能力，导致机器人要么能够高效移动物体但对用户输入缺乏响应，要么能够适应用户但依赖持续引导。我们的关键洞察在于，受障碍物约束的协作搬运需要将人类协作行为的预测与柔顺机器人控制相结合。为此，我们提出了PROACT框架，一种人机协作搬运方案，该框架通过学习人类协作行为模型，将预测机制融入柔顺全身控制中。基于大规模、真实世界的人-人搬运演示数据集进行训练，我们的Transformer架构将协作行为提炼为对未来物体运动的预测。在采用9自由度移动机械臂进行的108次真实世界试验中，与仅柔顺控制及模型预测控制（MPC）基线相比，PROACT分别将平均交互功减少了59.2%和20.4%，平均完成时间减少了12.9%和6.9%。实验视频可见于 https://youtu.be/qAGQvVPjbk。

title: JAMB: Joint Action-Motion Diffusion for Bimanual Manipulation
summary: Coordinated bimanual manipulation is challenging because the motion of either arm can alter the shared 3D scene and thereby affect the other arm. Yet most diffusion policies generate actions without explicitly modeling these future geometric consequences, while predictive variants typically use future state only as auxiliary supervision or fixed conditioning. We address this limitation by proposing JAMB, a diffusion policy that jointly denoises bimanual actions and future 3D point tracks. By allowing action and track hypotheses to evolve together within a shared Transformer, each can inform and refine the other throughout denoising. We further ground multimodal representations in a shared spatiotemporal coordinate system to facilitate geometry-aware interaction during joint denoising. We evaluate JAMB on diverse bimanual manipulation tasks in RoboTwin 2.0 and on a real-world robot, comparing it with action-only policies and alternative future-prediction approaches spanning different state representations and learning objectives. Across 16 simulation tasks, JAMB achieves an average success rate of 83.4%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 23.9 percentage points. On three real-world tasks, it outperforms the action-only and auxiliary geometry prediction methods by 50.0 and 21.2 percentage points, respectively. Beyond these performance gains, JAMB shows stronger generalization to cluttered scenes and out-of-distribution backgrounds than the evaluated baselines. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of our joint action-motion modeling framework for coordinated bimanual manipulation. Our project website is available at https://jam-bimanual.github.io/
tldr: JAMB is a diffusion policy that jointly denoises bimanual actions and future 3D point tracks in a shared Transformer, improving coordination and generalization in bimanual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: JAMB 是一种扩散策略，在共享 Transformer 中联合去噪双手动作和未来 3D 点轨迹，提高了双手操作任务的协调性和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 协调双臂操作颇具挑战性，因为任一只手臂的运动都可能改变共享的三维场景，从而影响另一只手臂。然而，多数扩散策略在生成动作时并未显式建模这些未来的几何后果，而预测类变体通常仅将未来状态用作辅助监督或固定条件。为克服这一局限，我们提出JAMB——一种联合去噪双臂动作与未来三维点轨迹的扩散策略。通过让动作假设与轨迹假设在共享Transformer中协同演化，二者可在整个去噪过程中相互提示与精化。我们进一步将多模态表示锚定于共享的时空坐标系，以促进联合去噪过程中的几何感知交互。我们在RoboTwin 2.0及真实机器人上对JAMB进行了评估，涵盖多种双臂操作任务，并将其与仅基于动作的策略以及采用不同状态表征和学习目标的多种未来预测方法进行对比。在全部16项仿真任务中，JAMB平均成功率达83.4%，较最强基线高出23.9个百分点。在三项真实世界任务中，其成功率分别较仅动作方法和辅助几何预测方法高出50.0和21.2个百分点。除性能提升外，JAMB在杂乱场景及分布外背景下的泛化能力也强于所评估的基线方法。综上，这些结果验证了我们面向协调双臂操作的联合动作-运动建模框架的有效性。项目网站见https://jam-bimanual.github.io/。

title: φ-RIE: From Photorealistic Reconstruction to Interactive Environments
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reconstruct a captured scene photorealistically, but the resulting representation does not by itself support physical interaction. Robot simulation instead requires object-level change, \textit{i.e.}, objects must move independently, make contact, and reveal previously occluded surroundings. This gap arises because object appearance may remain entangled with the background, while hidden object geometry and occluded background content may be unobserved. To address this challenge, we present φ-RIE, a Gaussian-native pipeline that converts selected objects into movable simulator assets while preserving the remaining reconstruction. Our key observation is that asset construction and source removal should be coupled, \textit{i.e.}, one object identity should define the movable asset and the scene content to remove and complete. Accordingly, Scene Observation supplies shared evidence to Coupled Scene Construction, which creates registered assets and completed background Gaussians for simulator-driven rendering in an Interactive Environment. This coupling preserves unedited Gaussians while aligning visual and physical state. On 50 ScanNet++ scenes, evidence-based selection and registration retry increase matched F1 at 20\,mm from 0.336 to 0.383 at fixed retention. Further tests demonstrate asset executability, manipulation gains over a single-generator baseline, and the visual cost of conversion. Together, these results demonstrate that \name\ enables interactive scene conversion.
tldr: φ-RIE converts 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes into interactive robot simulation environments by coupling movable asset construction with background completion and removal, enabling object-level physics interaction while preserving the base reconstruction.
tldr_zh: φ-RIE 将 3D 高斯泼溅场景转换为可交互的机器人仿真环境，通过将可移动资产构建与背景补全和移除耦合，在保持基础重建的同时实现物体级物理交互。
summary_zh: 三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够以照片级真实感重建所拍摄的场景，但由此得到的表示本身并不支持物理交互。机器人仿真则要求对象级别的变化，即对象必须能够独立移动、发生接触，并揭示先前被遮挡的周边环境。这一差距的产生是因为对象外观可能与背景纠缠在一起，同时隐藏的对象几何和被遮挡的背景内容可能未被观测到。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了φ-RIE，一个基于高斯的原生流水线，能够将所选对象转换为可移动的仿真资产，同时保留其余的重建结果。我们的关键观察在于，资产构建与源移除应当耦合，即一个对象身份应同时定义可移动资产以及需要移除并补全的场景内容。因此，场景观测为耦合场景构建提供共享证据，后者创建配准的资产和补全后的背景高斯，以便在交互环境中由仿真器驱动渲染。这种耦合保留了未经编辑的高斯，同时使视觉状态与物理状态保持一致。在50个ScanNet++场景上，基于证据的选择和配准重试在固定保留率下将20毫米处的匹配F1分数从0.336提升至0.383。进一步的测试展示了资产的可执行性、相较于单生成器基线的操控增益，以及转换的视觉代价。综合这些结果，我们证明了φ-RIE能够实现交互式场景转换。

title: Backdoors in Learning-Based Industrial Robotic Arm Manipulation: An Empirical Security Study
summary:
Learning-based models (e.g., visuomotor and Vision-Language-Action (VLA)) are increasingly explored for industrial robotic manipulation, where model predictions are directly translated into physical actions. This tight coupling between model behavior and physical execution makes hidden security vulnerabilities particularly consequential. While backdoor attacks have been widely studied in conventional AI models, their effects on deployed learning-based robotic arm manipulation systems remain less understood: a backdoored robot can behave normally during benign operation while inducing attacker-specified behaviors only when specific triggers are present, posing potentially serious risks in physical environments.
  In this work, we present a preliminary empirical security study of backdoor attacks and defenses in learning-based robotic manipulation on two real commercial industrial robotic arms (FANUC and xArm). We investigate whether a backdoor can reliably induce semantically incorrect manipulation behaviors while remaining stealthy under nominal task execution. We then develop an online defense pipeline that detects and neutralizes triggers at runtime, and compare its effectiveness against an offline fine-tuning defense. Beyond defense effectiveness, we further evaluate the computational latency and execution overhead introduced by the defense pipeline to assess its suitability for high-throughput industrial operation.
tldr: This paper empirically studies backdoor attacks and defenses in learning-based robotic arm manipulation on real industrial robots (FANUC and xArm), proposing an online defense pipeline against runtime trigger detection for safe operation.
tldr_zh: 本文在真实工业机械臂(FANUC和xArm)上实证研究了学习型机器人操作中的后门攻击与防御,提出在线防御流程用于运行时触发器检测以确保安全操作。
summary_zh:
基于学习的模型（例如视觉运动模型和视觉-语言-动作模型）正越来越多地应用于工业机器人操作领域，其中模型预测直接被转化为物理动作。模型行为与物理执行之间的这种紧密耦合，使得隐藏的安全漏洞尤为关键。虽然后门攻击在传统人工智能模型中已被广泛研究，但其对已部署的基于学习的机械臂操作系统的实际影响仍知之甚少：被植入后门的机器人在正常运行期间表现正常，但仅在特定触发器出现时才诱发攻击者指定的行为，这在物理环境中可能构成严重风险。

在本研究中，我们对基于学习的机器人操作系统中的后门攻击与防御进行了初步实证安全研究，实验平台为两台真实的商用工业机械臂（FANUC和xArm）。我们探讨了后门是否能够在名义任务执行过程中保持隐蔽的同时，可靠地诱发语义错误的操作行为。随后，我们开发了一种在线防御流程，能够在运行时检测并中和触发器，并将其有效性与离线微调防御方法进行了比较。除防御效果外，我们进一步评估了防御流程引入的计算延迟和执行开销，以评估其在高吞吐量工业作业中的适用性。

title: Beyond End-Task Success: How to Audit Visual Experience Retrieval in Robotics
summary: Robots that store past experiences must select which one to reuse in a new scene. Most systems select by visual similarity, and most evaluations report only the success of the selected experience. That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. Since robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining, a score that describes the library rather than the rule misleads what the field builds next. We contribute an audit methodology: execute every stored experience in every query scene, over two manipulation tasks, three reuse mechanisms, and libraries of $K=3$, $10$, and $50$. Because every alternative's outcome is known, a score can be traced to per-scene selection or to library quality. The audited rules select by nearest-neighbor distance in five visual embeddings, from raw pixels to CLIP. (1) One fixed experience, chosen with hindsight, captures 30-58% of the gap between random selection and an oracle; per-scene selection competes for the remaining 0.07-0.15 in success rate. (2) At $K\ge10$, visual rules concentrate on one experience 1.5-3 times more than the oracle does, and their scores then follow that experience's quality. (3) Wherever a rule differs significantly from a shuffle that keeps its selection rates but pairs them with scenes at random, the rule is worse, for every learned image policy. (4) Visual distance predicts well whether a given pair will succeed (AUROC up to 0.96), yet ranks the candidates within one scene no better than chance for four of five embeddings at $K=50$ (AUROC 0.45-0.52). Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the audit reduces to two cheap reports any study can give: the distribution of selected experiences, and the success of the best single experience in hindsight.
tldr: This paper introduces an audit methodology for visual experience retrieval in robotics, evaluating selection rules and library quality by exhaustively executing all experiences across scenes. It finds that fixed hindsight-chosen experiences capture much of the performance gap and that visual embeddings often fail to rank candidates effectively within a scene.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人视觉经验检索的审计方法，通过在所有场景中穷举执行所有经验来评估选择规则和库质量。研究发现，事后选择的固定经验能捕获大部分性能差距，而视觉嵌入往往无法在场景内有效排序候选经验。
summary_zh: 摘要：存储过往经验的机器人必须在新场景中决定复用哪条经验。大多数系统依据视觉相似度进行选择，且多数评估仅报告所选经验是否成功。该数字无法体现选择本身的好坏：某条规则可能因反复使用一条广泛可迁移的经验而得分较高，也可能因其偏好的经验较弱而得分偏低。由于机器人日益依赖经验复用而非重新训练进行自适应，因此，描述经验库而非规则本身的评分会误导领域后续的研究方向。我们提出一种审计方法：在两个操作任务、三种复用机制、以及经验库规模K分别为3、10和50的条件下，逐条执行每条存储经验于每个查询场景中。由于所有备选方案的结果均为已知，任何评分均可追溯至逐场景的选择质量或经验库自身的质量。被审计的规则依据五种视觉嵌入（从原始像素到CLIP）中的最近邻距离进行选择。（1）若从事后视角选定一条固定经验，其可捕获随机选择与理想选择之间差距的30%–58%；逐场景选择则需争夺其余0.07–0.15的成功率差异。（2）当K≥10时，视觉规则对单条经验的集中程度是理想选择者的1.5–3倍，其得分随之取决于该经验的质量。（3）凡规则的表现显著不同于保持其选择率但将经验与场景随机配对的洗牌策略时，该规则反而更差——这一结论对所有已学习的图像策略均成立。（4）视觉距离能较好预测某给定配对是否成功（AUROC最高达0.96），但在K=50时，五种嵌入中有四种对同一场景内候选方案的排序能力仅与随机水平相当（AUROC为0.45–0.52）。穷举执行通常不可行，因此该审计可简化为任何研究均可提供的两项低成本报告：所选经验的分布，以及事后视角下最优单一经验是否成功。

title: FLINT: Fast Lightweight Inference for Traversability
summary: Navigation in off-road conditions is challenging due to the lack of structure. There is no fixed vocabulary for what is traversable. The traversability depends on both the environment and the embodiment's dynamics. Neither of these two variables can be hand-labeled at scale. Thus, traversability has to be learned by the embodiment's own experience. Modern platforms tend to use multiple sensors to estimate traversability and navigate: RGBD cameras, lidar, radar, IMU, with computationally intensive platforms to run inference on neural networks. Against this trend, we propose FLINT, a lightweight traversability estimator: a 21.6M-parameter backbone, 38\times smaller than a comparable foundation-model backbone, that scores higher on held-out terrain probes and runs at 14.7 FPS on CPU alone using a RGB camera has the only sensor. Despite that gap in scale, FLINT produces a cheaper, more accurate costmap than a deployed foundation-model system (WildOS) on 23 of 24 replayed field logs. We compare different self-supervised learning signals and deploy the resulting models on a real platform in closed-loop field trials: the best self-supervised head reaches 99% autonomy over the route, outperforming a human-label-trained baseline deployed live on the same course. Our results show that heavy sensing and computing are not necessary for traversability estimation.
tldr: FLINT is a lightweight, camera-only traversability estimator for off-road navigation that uses self-supervised learning to achieve higher accuracy and faster inference than a much larger foundation-model-based system, while enabling high autonomy in real-world field trials.
tldr_zh: FLINT 是一种仅使用相机的轻量级越野可通行性估计器，通过自监督学习，在准确性和推理速度上优于规模大得多的基础模型系统，并在真实场地试验中实现了高自主性。
summary_zh: 在越野环境中导航因缺乏结构而极具挑战性。对于何种地形可通行，并不存在固定的词汇定义。可通行性既取决于环境，也取决于载体自身的动力学特性。这两个变量均无法大规模人工标注。因此，可通行性必须通过载体自身的经验来学习。现代平台通常使用多种传感器来估计可通行性并进行导航：RGBD相机、激光雷达、雷达、IMU，并配备计算密集型平台以运行神经网络推理。与这一趋势相反，我们提出了FLINT，一种轻量级可通行性估计器：其主干网络仅含2160万参数，比同类基础模型主干小38倍，在保留地形探针上得分更高，且仅使用RGB相机作为唯一传感器，便可在CPU上以14.7 FPS运行。尽管规模差距巨大，FLINT在24段回放野外日志中的23段上，生成了比已部署的基础模型系统（WildOS）更廉价且更精确的成本图。我们比较了不同的自监督学习信号，并在闭环现场试验中将所得模型部署于真实平台：最优自监督头在路线上的自主率达到99%，优于在同一路线现场部署的基于人工标注训练的基线。我们的结果表明，重型感知与计算并非可通行性估计的必要条件。

title: Generalizing Manipulation Skills with a Local Coding Agent
summary: Today, progress in open-weight language models enables systems capable of writing, executing and debugging code while still running on a single workstation. Most language-driven robots give the model a fixed action interface or a trained policy. Generalizing to a new task therefore means more engineering effort or more data collection, both time-consuming. We investigate whether a local open-weight vision-language model can control a robot and one-shot generalize to new variations of a task without new human programming or training. We let a local open-weight VLM, Qwen3.8-27B, drive a UR3e robotic arm from a coding-agent harness. It writes and runs its own code above a service that implements kinematics, safety limits and classic computer vision techniques. We investigate if this system is capable of generalizing to unseen tasks. Specifically, we test it on nine tasks built from children's toys designed to probe generalization capability across various object characteristics: color, size, shape, and task variation of those. With five trials for each task, we observe generalization in 30 out of 45 trials with durations ranging from 3.4 to 67.5 minutes depending on task complexity. We further test if there is a speedup when an agent is asked to redo the task after successful completion. This resulted in a 50% reduction in duration, indicating that there is self-improvement over time. Finally, we expose the limitations of a local coding agent. We believe that solving those limitations combined with further investigation of self-improvement over time points at a direct path toward real-world deployment of a local coding agent.
tldr: This paper explores using a local open-weight VLM as a coding agent to control a UR3e robot arm, writing and executing its own code to generalize one-shot to new task variations without additional training or programming. The system showed generalization in 30/45 trials across nine toy-based tasks and demonstrated a 50% time reduction on repeat attempts, highlighting both potential and limitations for real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文探索使用本地开源视觉语言模型作为编码代理控制UR3e机械臂，通过编写和执行代码实现对未见任务变体的一次性泛化，无需额外训练或编程。在九项基于玩具的任务中，系统在45次试验中泛化成功30次，并在重复任务中耗时减少50%，展示了实际部署的潜力与局限。
summary_zh: 如今，开放权重语言模型的进步使得系统能够在单台工作站上完成代码编写、执行及调试工作。多数语言驱动的机器人会为模型提供一个固定的操作接口或经过训练的策略。因此，要将机器人泛化到新任务，往往意味着需要投入更多的工程努力或收集更多的数据，这两者都相当耗时。我们探讨了一个本地开放的视觉-语言模型是否能够控制机器人，并在无需新的人工编程或训练的情况下，一次性泛化到任务的新变体。我们让本地开放的视觉-语言模型Qwen3.8-27B，通过一个编码智能体框架驱动UR3e机械臂。它在实现运动学、安全限制及经典计算机视觉技术的服务之上，编写并运行自身代码。我们研究了该系统是否能够泛化到未见过的任务。具体而言，我们在基于儿童玩具构建的九项任务上进行了测试，这些任务旨在探测量化泛化能力，覆盖了不同物体特征：颜色、大小、形状以及这些特征的任务变体。每个任务进行五次试验，我们发现在45次试验中有30次成功泛化，任务时长根据复杂度不同从3.4分钟到67.5分钟不等。我们还进一步测试了智能体在成功完成任务后再次执行同一任务时是否有提速效果，结果显示任务时长缩短了50%，表明存在随时间推移的自我改进。最后，我们揭示了本地编码智能体的局限性。我们认为，解决这些局限性并进一步研究随时间的自我改进，为本地编码智能体的实际部署指明了一条直接路径。

title: Dr-LiSA: Direct Radar-Lidar Scan Alignment for $SE(3)$ Localization
summary: This paper introduces Dr-LiSA, a first-of-its-kind direct method for localizing 2D spinning radar intensity measurements in $SE(3)$ against 3D lidar maps. Radar-lidar localization combines the complementary strengths of the two sensing modalities: radar is robust to adverse weather and precipitation, while lidar provides high-fidelity 3D maps in favourable conditions. However, existing radar-lidar localization methods are restricted to planar $SE(2)$ localization and have generally fallen short of the accuracy achieved by lidar-lidar and even radar-radar systems. A key challenge is the substantial sensing-modality gap between radar and lidar, which observe and represent scene structure in fundamentally different ways. Dr-LiSA bridges this gap using a learned forward model that predicts radar measurements from a lidar submap at a candidate pose, enabling direct photometric alignment of predicted and observed radar scans in $SE(3)$. Dr-LiSA outperforms prior radar-lidar approaches in $SE(2)$ while achieving planar accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art radar-radar localization across more than 90 km of on-road data.
tldr: Dr-LiSA introduces a direct SE(3) localization method that aligns 2D spinning radar intensity scans to 3D lidar maps via a learned forward model, achieving state-of-the-art radar-lidar accuracy.
tldr_zh: Dr-LiSA 提出了一种直接 SE(3) 定位方法，通过学习的前向模型将 2D 旋转雷达强度扫描与 3D 激光雷达地图对齐，达到了雷达-激光雷达定位的最佳精度。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了Dr-LiSA，这是一种首创的直接方法，用于在SE(3)空间中，将二维旋转雷达强度测量值相对于三维激光雷达地图进行定位。雷达-激光雷达定位结合了两种传感模式的互补优势：雷达对恶劣天气和降水具有鲁棒性，而激光雷达在良好条件下能够提供高保真的三维地图。然而，现有的雷达-激光雷达定位方法仅限于平面SE(2)定位，且其精度普遍不及激光雷达-激光雷达，甚至雷达-雷达系统。一个关键挑战在于雷达与激光雷达之间存在显著的传感模态差异，两者以根本不同的方式观察和表示场景结构。Dr-LiSA通过一种学习得到的前向模型弥合了这一差距，该模型能够从候选位姿处的激光雷达子地图预测雷达测量值，从而在SE(3)空间中实现预测雷达扫描与观测雷达扫描的直接光度对齐。在超过90公里的道路数据上，Dr-LiSA在SE(2)定位中优于先前的雷达-激光雷达方法，同时其平面精度与最先进的雷达-雷达定位方法相当。

title: AeRSoM: An Aerial Rigid-Soft Integrated Manipulator for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich aerial manipulation remains fundamentally challenging because interaction forces are directly transmitted to the aerial platform, often leading to instability and degraded task performance. While compliant manipulators can mitigate these effects, existing aerial manipulation systems typically struggle to reconcile interaction compliance with manipulation precision. To this end, this article presents an aerial rigid-soft integrated manipulator (AeRSoM) robot that realizes embodied compliance for aerial manipulation. The proposed system integrates a fully actuated aerial platform, a rigid-soft manipulator, and variable-stiffness regulation to simultaneously achieve stable flight, compliant interaction, and precise manipulation. By distributing compliance throughout the manipulation system, the proposed design leverages distributed embodied compliance to passively absorb contact disturbances while preserving sufficient stiffness for task execution. To fully exploit the mechanical design, a composite control framework is developed for precise end-effector trajectory tracking in the presence of uncertainties and external disturbances. Extensive real-world experiments are conducted in representative contact-rich aerial manipulation tasks, including dynamic transmission-line grasping, physical interaction with a wind turbine blade, peg-in-hole, and screwing operations. The results demonstrate that the proposed rigid-soft integration significantly improves interaction robustness and task adaptability while maintaining manipulation accuracy, highlighting that embodied compliance provides a promising design paradigm for enhancing the safety, robustness, and versatility of aerial manipulation.
tldr: This paper presents a rigid-soft integrated aerial manipulator robot with variable-stiffness regulation and a composite control framework for contact-rich tasks like peg-in-hole and screwing, demonstrating improved robustness and precision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种刚柔耦合的空中机械臂系统，通过可变刚度调节和复合控制框架，在动态抓取、插孔和拧螺丝等接触丰富的任务中实现了稳定性和精确性的统一。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的空中操作仍面临根本性挑战，因为交互力直接传递至空中平台，常常导致不稳定及任务性能下降。尽管柔性机械臂能够缓解这些影响，现有空中操作系统通常难以兼顾交互柔顺性与操作精度。为此，本文提出了一种空中刚柔一体化机械臂（AeRSoM）机器人，实现了空中操作的具身柔顺性。所提出的系统集成了全驱动空中平台、刚柔机械臂以及变刚度调节，以同时实现稳定飞行、柔顺交互和精准操作。通过在整个操作系统中分布柔顺性，该设计利用分布式具身柔顺性被动吸收接触干扰，同时保持足够的刚度以完成任务执行。为充分利用机械设计优势，开发了一种复合控制框架，用于在存在不确定性和外部干扰的情况下实现精确的末端执行器轨迹跟踪。在具有代表性的接触丰富空中操作任务中开展了大量实际实验，包括动态输电线抓取、与风力发电机叶片的物理交互、销孔装配及拧螺丝操作。结果表明，所提出的刚柔一体化设计在保持操作精度的同时，显著提升了交互鲁棒性和任务适应性，凸显出具身柔顺性为增强空中操作的安全性、鲁棒性和多功能性提供了一种有前景的设计范式。

title: Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects Using Model Predictive Path Integral Control with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Learning
summary: The manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) such as cables poses a significant challenge for automation due to their infinite degrees of freedom and non-linear dynamics. In this paper we present a machine learning based optimal control approach for the manipulation of DLOs. This approach is divided into two main components: modeling and control. For modeling the dynamics of the DLO, we propose a learning based approach using a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (biLSTM) network. The biLSTM network is trained on synthetic data generated by the MuJoCo physics engine. For manipulating the DLO, a model predictive control strategy that employs Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is selected. The proposed approach is evaluated through simulation and experiments. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in achieving accurate and efficient manipulation of DLOs.
tldr: This paper presents a learning-based optimal control approach for deformable linear object (DLO) manipulation, combining a biLSTM dynamics model trained on MuJoCo synthetic data with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, validated in simulation and experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于学习的柔性线性物体最优控制方法，结合在MuJoCo合成数据上训练的双向LSTM动力学模型与MPPI控制，并在仿真和实验中验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 可变形线性物体（DLOs），如线缆，因其具有无限自由度及非线性动力学特性，对自动化操作构成了重大挑战。本文提出了一种基于机器学习的最优控制方法，用于DLOs的操作。该方法主要分为建模与控制两个核心部分。在DLO动力学建模方面，我们采用了一种基于双向长短期记忆（biLSTM）网络的学习方法，该网络利用MuJoCo物理引擎生成的合成数据进行训练。在DLO操作控制上，我们选择了采用模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制的模型预测控制策略。通过仿真与实验对所提方法进行了评估，结果表明该方法在实现DLOs精确高效操作方面具有有效性。

title: Manipulation with Stability Guarantees: Linear Deformable Objects with Non-negligible Physical Response Grasped at Multiple Location
summary: Most research on the manipulation of deformable objects focuses on lightweight systems with negligible mechanical response, effectively restricting attention to quasi-static regimes. This assumption excludes a broad class of practically relevant objects, such as hoses, pipes, and wiring harnesses, whose dynamics cannot be ignored during manipulation. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a closed-loop control architecture that explicitly accounts for object dynamics and recasts manipulation as a shape-regulation problem. Control is achieved by modulating forces and torques applied at multiple fixed points along the object. This approach builds on three methodological contributions: a fully dynamic model of linear deformable objects based on discrete strain parameterizations; an extension of the notion of actuation coordinates to SE(3), yielding a structured and inherently underactuated control architecture; and nonlinear feedback strategies providing explicit conditions for steady-state convergence to desired configurations. Extensive simulations on representative manipulation tasks demonstrate the performance gains enabled by the proposed modelbased formulation. We finally validate the approach experimentally through a real-time closed-loop implementation with online shape estimation, confirming its practical feasibility and effectiveness
tldr: This paper presents a closed-loop control architecture for manipulating linear deformable objects with non-negligible dynamics via multi-point grasping, using a dynamic model, SE(3) actuation coordinates, and nonlinear feedback with stability guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种闭环控制架构，用于在多抓取点下操作具有不可忽略动态的线性可变形物体，通过动态模型、SE(3)驱动坐标和非线性反馈提供稳定性保证。
summary_zh: 大多数关于可变形物体操作的研究都聚焦于机械响应可忽略的轻量系统，实际上将关注范围限定在准静态情境中。这一假设排除了大量实际相关物体，例如软管、管道和线束，这些物体在操作过程中的动力学特性不可忽视。在本工作中，我们通过引入一种显式考虑物体动力学的闭环控制架构来弥补这一局限，并将操作问题重新表述为形状调节问题。控制通过调节沿物体多个固定点处施加的力和力矩来实现。该方法建立在三项方法论贡献之上：基于离散应变参数化的线性可变形物体全动态模型；将驱动坐标的概念推广至SE(3)，从而形成结构化且固有欠驱动的控制架构；以及提供稳态收敛至期望构型的显式条件的非线性反馈策略。在代表性操作任务上的大量仿真证明了所提出的基于模型的方法所带来的性能提升。最后，我们通过结合在线形状估计的实时闭环实现进行了实验验证，确认了该方法的实际可行性和有效性。

title: What is the Better Curriculum: Controller-Shaped Grasping Behavior for Contact Force-Sensitive Manipulation
summary: How should a robot learn to manipulate objects so fragile that sub-Newton contact forces can cause irreversible damage? Existing visuo-tactile policy learning typically treats tactile sensing as an additional policy input. In direct-contact force-sensitive manipulation, however, the bottleneck can arise earlier, during data collection: manual gripper control is too delayed and coarse-grained to reliably maintain the narrow force range required for stable grasping. We therefore use a deterministic 25 Hz tactile reflex controller as a collection-time teacher, producing demonstrations with controller-shaped grasping behavior for tactile-free policy learning. On Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), policies trained from reflex-shaped demonstrations recover the teacher's grasping profile and achieve 95% stable grasps on the nominal plastic-cup task, substantially outperforming visually screened manual demonstrations. The same intervention improves in-distribution stability on $π_{0.5}$ and shows a favorable exploratory trend on an unseen paper-cup variant. Under randomized external disturbance, however, the reflex-data $π_{0.5}$ policy still fails in 45% of policy-only trials, whereas a deployment-time reflex arbiter retains all grasps. These results reveal a new role for tactile feedback in force-sensitive manipulation: rather than integrating tactile into the policy, we use it as a collection-time teacher that shapes grasping behavior in demonstrations for policy learning, while disturbance rejection remains controller-dependent, revealing the boundary of tactile-free policy.
tldr: This paper proposes using a 25 Hz tactile reflex controller as a collection-time teacher to generate demonstrations with controller-shaped grasping behavior for training tactile-free policies (ACT, π0.5) in force-sensitive manipulation, showing improved grasp stability on fragile objects and revealing the boundary where deployment-time reflex arbitration is still needed for disturbance rejection.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出使用25Hz触觉反射控制器作为数据采集时的教师，生成具有控制器塑形抓取行为的演示，用于训练无触觉策略（ACT、π0.5）以进行力敏感操作，在易碎物体上提高了抓取稳定性，并揭示了在扰动抑制中仍需部署时反射仲裁的边界。
summary_zh: 机器人应如何学习操作那些即使亚牛顿接触力也能造成不可逆损伤的易碎物体？现有的视觉-触觉策略学习通常将触觉感知作为策略的额外输入。然而，在直接接触力敏感的操作任务中，瓶颈可能更早出现，即在数据采集阶段：手动夹爪控制过于延迟且粗粒度，难以可靠地维持稳定抓取所需的狭窄力范围。因此，我们采用一个确定性的25 Hz触觉反射控制器作为采集阶段的教师，生成具有控制器塑造的抓取行为的示范数据，用于无触觉策略学习。在基于Transformer的动作分块（ACT）框架下，由反射塑造示范训练得到的策略能够复现教师的抓取特征，在标称塑料杯任务中实现95%的稳定抓取，显著优于经视觉筛选的人工示范。同样的干预措施提升了$π_{0.5}$策略在分布内的稳定性，并在未见过的纸杯变体上展现出有利的探索趋势。然而，在随机外部扰动下，基于反射数据的$π_{0.5}$策略在仅依赖策略的试验中仍有45%的失败率，而部署阶段的反射仲裁器则能保持所有抓取成功。这些结果揭示了触觉反馈在力敏感操作中的新作用：我们并非将触觉集成到策略中，而是将其作为采集阶段的教师，在示范数据中塑造抓取行为以用于策略学习，而扰动抑制仍依赖控制器，从而揭示了无触觉策略的能力边界。

title: PLAT: Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking for Humanoid Control via Privileged Latent Transition Learning
summary: Humanoid motion tracking policies rely on dense frame-by-frame references, limiting their use as high-level motion controllers for planning and interactive motion generation. We study \emph{Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking}, where a policy receives only sparse future keyframes and their desired arrival times, and must execute stable whole-body motions that reach successive goals. We propose \textbf{PLAT}, a three-stage sparse timed keyframe motion tracking policy learning framework with \textbf{P}rivileged \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{T}ransition learning. PLAT bridges dense motion tracking and sparse goal-conditioned control by exploiting dense goal sequences as privileged supervision during training while requiring only sparse timed keyframe commands at deployment. A pretrained dense tracking expert first provides robust motion priors. A privileged latent prior is then learned through DAgger-style imitation, followed by latent residual reinforcement learning that refines latent transitions instead of directly optimizing actions. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate that PLAT maintains accurate and stable sparse timed keyframe tracking across varying planning horizons, with particularly strong performance under long-horizon commands. Successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot further demonstrates the effectiveness and practicality of PLAT for sparse humanoid motion control.
tldr: PLAT proposes a three-stage privileged latent transition learning framework that enables humanoid control policies to track sparse timed keyframes, bridging dense motion tracking and sparse goal-conditioned control, and demonstrates stable long-horizon tracking and real-robot deployment on a Unitree G1.
tldr_zh: PLAT 提出了一种三阶段特权潜在转移学习框架，使仿人控制策略能够跟踪稀疏定时关键帧，弥合密集运动跟踪与稀疏目标条件控制之间的差距，并在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上展示了稳定的长时程跟踪和实际部署。
summary_zh: 类人运动跟踪策略依赖于密集的逐帧参考，这限制了其作为高层运动控制器在规划和交互式运动生成中的应用。我们研究**稀疏定时关键帧运动跟踪**问题，其中策略仅接收稀疏的未来关键帧及其期望到达时间，并需执行稳定的全身运动以依次到达各目标。我们提出**PLAT**，一种三阶段的稀疏定时关键帧运动跟踪策略学习框架，采用**特**权**潜**在**转**移学习。PLAT通过利用密集目标序列作为训练阶段的特权监督，同时在部署时仅需稀疏定时关键帧指令，从而弥合了密集运动跟踪与稀疏目标条件控制之间的鸿沟。预训练的密集跟踪专家首先提供稳健的运动先验。随后通过DAgger式模仿学习获得特权潜在先验，再进行潜在残差强化学习，以优化潜在转移而非直接优化动作。大量仿真实验表明，PLAT在不同规划时域下均能保持准确且稳定的稀疏定时关键帧跟踪，尤其在长时域指令下表现出色。在Unitree G1类人机器人上的成功部署进一步验证了PLAT在稀疏类人运动控制中的有效性和实用性。

title: The Cartesian Hand: In-Hand Manipulation with All-Linear Fingers
summary: Robotic manipulation has increasingly pursued human-like dexterous hands with many articulated degrees of freedom, offering rich manipulation capabilities at the cost of mechanical and control complexity. At the other extreme, parallel grippers are simple and robust, but provide little ability to manipulate an object after grasping it. Operating articulated objects such as threaded containers, manufacturing tools, and laboratory instruments often requires a second gripper, an external fixture, or coordinated arm motion. We introduce the Cartesian Hand, a 7-DoF end-effector that rethinks dexterous manipulation by combining independent grasping and relative manipulation within a single end-effector using only linear motion. Two independently actuated parallel grippers hold different parts of an object, while four translating fingertips generate relative motion between the grasped parts. Its configuration-independent fingertip kinematics allow manipulation to be composed from simple linear motion primitives. The Cartesian Hand is particularly suited to objects structured around common mechanisms such as threads, pivots, linear guides, plungers, and triggers. We demonstrate cap opening and closing, pipetting, pumping, two-handle manipulation, screwdriving, trigger actuation, and in-grasp reorientation across 35 objects spanning laboratory, manufacturing, and household settings. The same manipulation procedures transfer from a fixed-base robot arm to a humanoid, where we demonstrate bimanual laboratory manipulation using two Cartesian Hands. These results show that versatile in-hand manipulation capability can emerge from a mechanically simple architecture when independent grasping and relative motion are designed directly into the end-effector. We will open-source all software and hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/cartesian_handv1.
tldr: The Cartesian Hand is a 7-DoF end-effector that uses two parallel grippers and four linear translational fingertips to achieve dexterous in-hand manipulation (e.g., cap opening, pipetting) with simple linear motions, demonstrated on 35 objects and on both fixed-base and humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: 笛卡尔手是一种7自由度末端执行器，通过两个平行夹爪和四个直线平移指尖实现灵巧的抓内操作（如开盖、移液），使用简单线性运动，已在35个物体及固定基座和人形机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 机器人操作领域一直追求具有多个关节自由度、类人灵巧手的发展，这类手部提供了丰富的操作能力，但代价是机械结构和控制系统的复杂性。而在另一个极端，平行夹爪虽然简单且稳健，但在抓取物体后几乎不具备操纵能力。操作诸如螺纹容器、制造工具和实验室仪器等关节式物体，往往需要第二个夹爪、外部固定装置或协调的手臂运动。我们提出了笛卡尔手——一种7自由度末端执行器，它通过对单一末端执行器内的独立抓取与相对操作进行重新设计，仅利用线性运动即可实现灵巧操作。两只独立驱动的平行夹爪分别夹持物体的不同部分，而四个平移指尖则在被抓取部分之间产生相对运动。其与构型无关的指尖运动学使得操作可由简单的直线运动基元组合而成。笛卡尔手特别适用于围绕螺纹、枢轴、直线导轨、柱塞和扳机等常见机构构建的物体。我们展示了在涵盖实验室、制造和家庭场景的35种物体上的瓶盖开合、移液、泵送、双柄操作、螺丝旋拧、扳机触发以及抓取内重定向等操作能力。相同的操作流程可从固定基座机械臂直接迁移至人形机器人上，我们利用两只笛卡尔手演示了双臂实验室操作。这些结果表明，当独立抓取与相对运动被直接设计进末端执行器时，多样化的手内操作能力可以从机械结构简单的架构中涌现出来。我们将开源所有软件和硬件设计。我们的网站是 https://generalroboticslab.com/cartesian_handv1。

title: Induced Riemannian Metrics for Motion Planning with Constraints
summary: In constrained motion planning problems, task and loop-closure constraints restrict a robot's motion to a curved, lower-dimensional submanifold of its configuration space. Planners measure path length with a metric, which sets the cost of moving in each direction. Under the Euclidean metric, this cost is the same everywhere, whereas under a general Riemannian metric, such as the kinetic-energy metric, the cost can vary with direction and configuration. Existing methods often describe the submanifold either implicitly, as a constraint level set, or explicitly, through a parameterization. The implicit representation is typically combined with the Euclidean metric of the configuration space, and the explicit representation with the parameter domain, so the path length that a planner minimizes depends on the representation. Instead, we measure path length with the induced metric, which the submanifold inherits from a Riemannian metric on the configuration space. The implicit and explicit representations yield the same induced metric, expressed in different coordinates, and hence the same geometry. This result holds for any Riemannian metric on the configuration space, not only the Euclidean one. The choice of metric is therefore independent of the choice of representation. Using this result, we extend planning under a Riemannian metric from unconstrained spaces to constraint submanifolds by applying the induced metric in both a sampling-based planner and a trajectory optimizer. For an explicit representation, the induced metric also accounts for the distortion that the parameterization introduces. In experiments on a bimanual manipulation setup with two Franka arms under end-effector task constraints, we compare the Euclidean and kinetic-energy metrics.
tldr: This paper shows that the induced Riemannian metric, inherited from the configuration space metric, unifies implicit and explicit constraint representations for motion planning on submanifolds, and demonstrates its use in a sampling-based planner and trajectory optimizer on a bimanual manipulation task with Franka arms under task constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文证明约束流形上由构型空间度量诱导的黎曼度量统一了隐式和显式约束表示，并将其用于采样规划和轨迹优化，在双臂Franka操作任务上验证了效果。
summary_zh: 在受约束的运动规划问题中，任务约束和闭环约束将机器人的运动限制在其构型空间的一个弯曲的低维子流形上。规划器通过度量来衡量路径长度，该度量设定了沿各方向移动的代价。在欧几里得度量下，这一代价在各处均相同；而在一般黎曼度量（如动能度量）下，代价可能随方向及构型的变化而不同。现有方法通常以隐式方式将子流形描述为约束水平集，或通过参数化以显式方式加以描述。隐式表示通常与构型空间的欧几里得度量结合使用，显式表示则与参数域结合使用，因此规划器所最小化的路径长度依赖于所采用的表示方式。相反，我们使用诱导度量来衡量路径长度，该度量是子流形从构型空间上的黎曼度量所继承而来的。隐式表示和显式表示在不同坐标下产生相同的诱导度量，因而具有相同的几何结构。这一结果对构型空间上的任意黎曼度量均成立，而不仅限于欧几里得度量。因此，度量的选择独立于表示方式的选择。基于这一结果，我们将黎曼度量下的规划从无约束空间扩展到约束子流形，方法是在基于采样的规划器和轨迹优化器中均应用诱导度量。对于显式表示，诱导度量还计入了参数化引入的畸变。在双臂操作设置（使用两个Franka机械臂）并施加末端执行器任务约束的实验中，我们比较了欧几里得度量和动能度量的效果。

title: MotionForge: A Data Generation Pipeline and Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon Manipulation of Dynamic Objects with Domain Shifts
summary: Recent advances in learning-based robot policies have demonstrated promising progress, yet they are predom- inantly evaluated in static or quasi-static environments. In dynamic manipulation, objects and scenes continuously evolve while the robot perceives, reasons, and acts. However, recent dynamic simulation benchmarks largely focus on short-horizon, reactive interactions with simple motion patterns and offer limited support for both systematic evaluation under domain shifts and model-agnostic real-time execution protocols. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MotionForge, the first large- scale simulation benchmark and data-generation pipeline tailored to jointly evaluate domain shifts and long-horizon interaction in dynamic manipulation. MotionForge comprises 40 dynamic interaction tasks spanning 11 distinct motion patterns, with dedicated support for 17 long-horizon tasks. Our benchmark introduces two key novelties: (1) a systematic evaluation protocol for assessing policy robustness under both single-factor (e.g., only backgrounds shift) and joint domain shifts (e.g., simultaneous shifts of objects, backgrounds, lighting, and speed); and (2) a decoupled, latency-aware execution protocol where the environ- ment continuously evolves independently of policy inference time. Extensive evaluations of representative general-purpose robot policies on our benchmark reveal substantial limitations under joint domain shifts. These findings expose a critical gap between current policy capabilities and the requirements of robust long- horizon manipulation of dynamic objects under domain shifts, establishing MotionForge as a comprehensive testbed for future research in embodied AI.
tldr: MotionForge introduces a large-scale simulation benchmark and data-generation pipeline for evaluating long-horizon dynamic manipulation policies under single and joint domain shifts, with a decoupled latency-aware execution protocol. Evaluations on representative policies reveal significant limitations under joint domain shifts.
tldr_zh: MotionForge 提出了一个大规模仿真基准和数据生成流水线，用于在单一和联合域偏移下评估长时程动态操作策略，并采用解耦的延迟感知执行协议。对代表性策略的评估揭示了其在联合域偏移下的显著局限性。
summary_zh: 近期基于学习的机器人策略取得了显著进展，但这些策略主要是在静态或准静态环境中进行评估。在动态操控中，机器人在感知、推理和行动的同时，物体和场景也在持续变化。然而，现有的动态仿真基准大多侧重于具有简单运动模式的短时程、反应式交互，并且对域偏移下的系统性评估以及模型无关的实时执行协议支持有限。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了MotionForge，这是首个面向动态操控中域偏移与长时程交互联合评估的大规模仿真基准与数据生成流水线。MotionForge包含40个动态交互任务，涵盖11种不同的运动模式，并专门支持17个长时程任务。我们的基准引入了两项关键创新：(1)一套系统性评估协议，用于在单因素域偏移（如仅背景变化）和联合域偏移（如物体、背景、光照和速度同时变化）下评估策略的鲁棒性；(2)一套解耦的、对延迟敏感的执行协议，其中环境独立于策略推理时间持续演化。我们在该基准上对具有代表性的通用机器人策略进行了广泛评估，结果揭示了这些策略在联合域偏移下的显著局限性。这些发现暴露了当前策略能力与域偏移下动态物体鲁棒长时程操控需求之间的关键差距，使MotionForge成为具身智能领域未来研究的综合测试平台。

title: CDKF-Track: Cluster-aware Data-Driven Kalman Filtering for Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) is essential for EdgeAI perception systems, where accurate object localization and reliable identification enable safe decision-making. Singleagent MOT suffers from occlusions, sensor noise, and partial scene understanding in complex real-world scenarios. While multi-agent systems improve robustness by exploiting shared information, they introduce redundant measurements that lead to false data associations, and still struggle to capture nonlinear object dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose CDKFTrack, a Cluster-aware Data-Driven Kalman Filtering framework for Cooperative 3D MOT. The proposed method first fuses multivehicle 3D LiDAR detections through a Graph Laplacian-based formulation. Then, a cluster-aware redundancy reduction scheme groups spatially related detections and selects representative observations to reduce duplicate inputs to the tracker. The resulting detections are processed by a data-driven Kalman filter that learns object motion dynamics from data, reducing dependence on predefined linear motion assumptions. Furthermore, a wavelet-based temporal refinement module leverages the multiresolution decomposition property of wavelets to attenuate shortterm positional fluctuations and improve trajectory continuity. To the best of our knowledge, CDKF-Track is the first framework to jointly address detection-level fusion redundancy and learnable motion modeling in cooperative 3D MOT. Experimental results on the real-world V2V4Real dataset indicate that CDKF-Track achieves up to 27.99% improvements in tracking accuracy over state-of-the-art multi-agent MOT methods.
tldr: This paper proposes CDKF-Track, a cooperative 3D multi-object tracking framework that fuses multi-vehicle LiDAR detections with Graph Laplacian, reduces redundant measurements via cluster-aware selection, and uses a data-driven Kalman filter with wavelet-based temporal refinement to improve tracking accuracy on the V2V4Real dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CDKF-Track，一种协作式3D多目标跟踪框架，通过图拉普拉斯融合多车辆LiDAR检测，利用簇感知冗余减少机制，并使用数据驱动卡尔曼滤波和小波时间细化模块，在V2V4Real数据集上显著提升跟踪精度。
summary_zh: 多目标跟踪（MOT）对于边缘人工智能感知系统至关重要，其中精确的目标定位和可靠的识别能力是实现安全决策的关键。在复杂的真实场景中，单智能体多目标跟踪容易受到遮挡、传感器噪声和场景理解不完整的影响。尽管多智能体系统通过利用共享信息增强了鲁棒性，但其引入了导致错误数据关联的冗余测量，并且在捕捉非线性目标动态方面仍存在困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CDKFTrack，一种用于协作式三维多目标跟踪的聚类感知数据驱动卡尔曼滤波框架。该方法首先通过基于图拉普拉斯算子的公式融合多车辆三维激光雷达检测结果。随后，一种聚类感知的冗余缩减方案将空间相关的检测进行分组，并选择具有代表性的观测值，以减少输入至跟踪器的重复数据。处理后的检测结果由数据驱动的卡尔曼滤波器进行处理，该滤波器从数据中学习目标运动动态，从而减少对预定义线性运动假设的依赖。此外，基于小波的时序细化模块利用小波的多分辨率分解特性来衰减短期位置波动，并改善轨迹连续性。据我们所知，CDKF-Track是第一个在协作式三维多目标跟踪中同时解决检测级融合冗余和可学习运动建模问题的框架。在真实世界V2V4Real数据集上的实验结果表明，CDKF-Track相较于最先进的多智能体多目标跟踪方法，在跟踪精度上实现了最高27.99%的提升。

title: Deploying Foundation Models for Embodied Navigation
summary: We present and tackle two problems associated with deploying Foundation Models (FMs) on Embodied Agents performing navigation: 1) Training bias in FMs leading to poor personalization in unseen environments, and 2) Limited FM context length hindering success, especially on long horizon tasks. Our solution for the former involves priming the FM with human-habit data mined from the scene and our solution for the latter involves active memory management via a novel `memory head' augmentation. We first present a taxonomy of existing literature on FM-based Embodied Navigation, and highlight these limitations. We then present our approaches, Transit-Aware Planning (TAP) and MemCtrl to address the limitations. With TAP, we present real-world results in a lab environment with a Turtlebot for personalized target finding that shows an average improvement of 18% over a non-TAP baseline. On MemCtrl, we report a 6% average improvement across various embodied tasks, with 20% on long instruction subsets, all while using nearly half the context used in the baseline model. Motivated by these result, we present our stance the deployability of FM-based embodied agents in real-world environments, and highlight open research directions.
tldr: This paper addresses deployment challenges of foundation models for embodied navigation by introducing Transit-Aware Planning (TAP) and MemCtrl, which improve personalization and long-horizon task performance on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文针对具身导航中基础模型部署的挑战，提出了TAP和MemCtrl方法，在真实机器人上提升了个性化和长时任务性能。
summary_zh: 我们提出并解决了两项与在具身智能体导航中部署基础模型相关的问题：1）基础模型中的训练偏差导致其在未见环境中个性化能力不足；2）基础模型有限的上下文长度制约任务成功率，尤其在长时程任务中表现突出。针对前者，我们的解决方案是利用从场景中挖掘的人类习惯数据对基础模型进行预提示；针对后者，我们提出通过一种新颖的“记忆头”扩展实现主动记忆管理。首先，我们梳理了基于基础模型的具身导航现有文献分类体系，并指出上述局限性。随后，我们提出相应方法——交通感知规划（TAP）与记忆控制（MemCtrl）以应对这些局限。借助TAP，我们在实验室环境中使用Turtlebot机器人进行了个性化目标查找的真实世界实验，结果显示相较于非TAP基线，平均性能提升18%。在MemCtrl方面，我们在多种具身任务中报告了平均6%的性能提升，其中长指令子集上提升达20%，同时所需上下文仅为基线模型的一半左右。受这些成果启发，我们阐述了基于基础模型的具身智能体在真实环境中可部署性的立场，并指出了开放的研究方向。

title: History-Conditioned Flow Matching for Probabilistic Dynamics of Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Deterministic dynamics modeling of tendon-driven continuum robots remains challenging owing to uncertainties in material behavior, tendon transmission, friction, and contact. Measured joint configurations and nominal tendon commands do not fully characterize these internal mechanical factors, leaving uncertainty in the subsequent motion. We therefore develop a history-conditioned, physics-informed flow-matching framework for probabilistic dynamics prediction, using motion and actuation histories to predict the distribution of the next complete joint configuration. By recursively sampling next-step configurations under prescribed commands, the model predicts distributions of future whole-body motions. In simulation, scenario-specific models achieve five-second trajectory Energy Scores (lower is better) of 12.05 mm under internal friction variation and 9.29 mm under unobserved actuation disturbances. Relative to the conditional variational autoencoder and diffusion baselines, Flow attains lower Energy Scores and coverage closer to the nominal level in both scenarios. Ablations support history and structural conditioning in both scenarios. On the physical robot, predictions under two tendon-command profiles excluded from training capture the principal motion sequences, with five-second Energy Scores of 11.91 and 11.42 mm, lower than the compared baselines. The predicted-to-measured spread ratios are 1.65 and 1.22 (closer to 1 is better). These results support history-conditioned probabilistic dynamics prediction under incomplete mechanical observations.
tldr: This paper presents a history-conditioned, physics-informed flow-matching framework for probabilistic dynamics prediction of tendon-driven continuum robots, using motion and actuation histories to predict the distribution of the next full joint configuration. The method demonstrates improved prediction accuracy and calibration compared to baselines in both simulation and physical robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于历史条件、物理信息流匹配的框架，用于肌腱驱动连续体机器人的概率动力学预测，利用运动和驱动历史预测下一完整关节配置的分布。在仿真和物理实验中，该方法相比基线提高了预测准确性和校准度。
summary_zh: 针对肌腱驱动连续体机器人的确定性动力学建模，由于材料行为、肌腱传动、摩擦及接触中的不确定性，仍面临挑战。测得的关节构型与名义肌腱指令并不能完全表征这些内部机械因素，从而为后续运动留下不确定性。为此，我们开发了一种基于历史条件、融合物理信息的流匹配框架，用于概率动力学预测，利用运动与驱动历史来预测下一完整关节构型的分布。通过在指定指令下递归采样下一步构型，该模型可预测未来整体运动的分布。在仿真中，针对特定场景的模型在内部摩擦变化下实现了12.05毫米的五秒轨迹能量分数（数值越低越好），在未观测驱动扰动下实现了9.29毫米。与条件变分自编码器和扩散基线相比，流匹配模型在两种场景中均获得了更低的能量分数，且覆盖率更接近标称水平。消融实验验证了历史与结构条件在两种场景中的有效性。在物理机器人上，针对两种未纳入训练的肌腱指令轮廓的预测捕捉了主要运动序列，五秒能量分数分别为11.91毫米和11.42毫米，低于对比基线。预测与实测的离散度比值分别为1.65和1.22（越接近1越优）。这些结果支持在不完整机械观测条件下进行基于历史条件的概率动力学预测。

title: CODA: Depth-Aligned Scene Completion and Object Decomposition from a Single RGB-D Image
summary: Robots operating safely in cluttered everyday environments often need to infer scene geometry from partial observations. Methods that detect objects in 2D and reconstruct them independently struggle in such scenes: a missed object is never reconstructed, a merged detection can fuse two objects, and separately reconstructed meshes may overlap or fail to touch their supporting surfaces. We introduce CODA (Complete Once, Decompose Afterward), a generative model that instead reconstructs the complete scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image, then separates the surface into the surrounding environment and movable objects. Still, generated scene geometry can drift from the observed partial point cloud. To reduce this drift, CODA uses two explicit 3D grounding mechanisms to keep reconstructed geometry consistent with observed surfaces while completing unseen regions. Experiments on HomebrewedDB and our custom cluttered-scene dataset show more accurate reconstructions and a higher fraction of objects remaining in place under simulated gravity than both object-first and scene-first baselines.
tldr: CODA is a generative model that completes scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image and decomposes it into the environment and movable objects, using explicit 3D grounding to reduce drift, improving reconstruction and object stability for robots in cluttered scenes.
tldr_zh: CODA 是一个生成模型，从单张未分割的RGB-D图像中完成场景几何重建，并将其分解为环境和可移动物体，利用显式3D接地减少漂移，提高杂乱场景中的重建精度和物体稳定性。
summary_zh: 机器人在杂乱日常环境中安全操作时，往往需要从部分观察中推断场景几何结构。在二维图像中检测物体并独立重建的方法在此类场景中表现不佳：漏检的物体永远无法被重建，合并的检测可能将两个物体融合为一体，而分别重建的网格可能相互重叠或未能与其支撑表面接触。我们提出了CODA（先完成，后分解），这是一种生成模型，能够从单张未分割的RGB-D图像中重建完整的场景几何结构，然后将表面分为周围环境和可移动物体两部分。然而，生成的场景几何结构可能偏离观察到的部分点云。为减少这种偏移，CODA采用两种显式三维接地机制，在保持重建几何结构与观察表面一致的同时，完成未见区域的补全。在HomebrewedDB及我们自建的杂乱场景数据集上的实验表明，与先物体后场景及先场景后物体的基线方法相比，CODA实现了更精确的重建，并且在模拟重力作用下，物体保持在原位上的比例更高。

title: Skill Sequence Planning for Collaborative Multi-Robot Construction
summary: Robots have significant potential to automate construction processes. However, their industry adoption remains limited, partly because of the programming effort required to adapt robots to diverse tasks. This paper presents a skill sequence planning method that enables a heterogeneous team of multi-functional robots to collaboratively perform construction assembly work using reusable, preprogrammed skills such as grasping, drilling, and fastening. A central controller transforms the digital representation of the building into a construction relationship graph that represents construction entities, their states, and their parent-child relationships. Based on this representation, the system selects the next construction target, generates a symbolic sequence of skills for capable members of the robot team, and produces collision-free geometric motion plans for skill execution. The symbolic planning problem is dynamically regenerated as the construction state changes. An interactive digital twin presents the planned skill sequence and robot states to human co-workers for review and approval before execution. The method is evaluated through a construction assembly case study. By reducing the need to program robots separately for each task variation, the proposed approach supports more flexible deployment of collaborative robot teams in construction.
tldr: This paper presents a skill sequence planning method for collaborative multi-robot construction, using a central controller that converts building digital representations into a construction relationship graph, generates symbolic skill sequences for heterogeneous robot teams, and produces collision-free motion plans, with an interactive digital twin for human review.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协作多机器人建造的技能序列规划方法，该方法通过中央控制器将建筑数字表示转换为建造关系图，为异构机器人团队生成符号技能序列，并生成无碰撞运动计划，同时提供交互式数字孪生以供人类审查。
summary_zh: 机器人具有显著潜力，能够实现施工过程的自动化。然而，其在行业中的应用仍然有限，部分原因在于将机器人适配至多样化任务所需的编程工作较为繁重。本文提出了一种技能序列规划方法，使得由多功能机器人组成的异构团队能够利用可复用的预编程技能（如抓取、钻孔和紧固）协作完成建筑装配工作。中央控制器将建筑物的数字表示转换为施工关系图，该图描述了施工实体、其状态及其父子关系。基于该表示，系统选择下一个施工目标，为机器人团队中具备相应能力的成员生成符号化的技能序列，并产出无碰撞的几何运动规划以执行技能。符号规划问题会随着施工状态的变化而动态重新生成。交互式数字孪生系统将规划好的技能序列和机器人状态呈现给人类协作者，供其在执行前进行审查和批准。该方法通过一个建筑装配案例研究进行了评估。通过减少针对每个任务变体单独编程机器人的需求，所提出的方法支持协作机器人团队在施工中更灵活的部署。

title: DynaForge: Planning-Guided Residual Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Demonstration Generation
summary: Dynamic object manipulation is essential for robots operating in real-world environments, yet methods for generating high-quality demonstrations remain limited. Methods designed for static tasks do not readily transfer to dynamic settings. Among dynamic demonstration generators, planning-based methods can fail near contact, while DOMINO-style replay simplifies dynamic interactions and may limit the experience available for policy learning. We present DynaForge, a planning-guided framework that learns residual corrections for dynamic manipulation demonstration generation. DynaForge combines low-frequency global planning with high-frequency object-centric inverse kinematics across task phases, and applies a residual policy to correct actions during dynamic interaction. An implicit curriculum groups rollouts under matched conditions and selects mixed-success groups, focusing residual reinforcement learning on the evolving competence frontier. On Can and Bottle, it uses 0.73x as many optimizer steps as vanilla GRPO at the same nominal environment-step budget, with higher observed final success rates. Across nine simulation tasks, DynaForge increases mean demonstration-generation success from 41.30% of the planning prior to 78.37%. With 800 demonstrations per task, DP3 policies trained on DynaForge data achieve 49.11% mean success, compared with 7.07% for DOMINO data. On three real-world dynamic tasks, DynaForge-trained policies achieve 30-60% success, compared with 0-10% for DOMINO-trained policies, showing the ability of DynaForge for sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: DynaForge is a planning-guided residual learning framework that generates high-quality dynamic manipulation demonstrations by combining global planning with a residual policy trained via reinforcement learning and an implicit curriculum, achieving significant improvements in simulation and real-world success rates over prior methods.
tldr_zh: DynaForge 是一个规划引导的残差学习框架，通过结合全局规划与强化学习训练的残差策略及隐式课程，生成高质量动态操作演示，在仿真和真实世界成功率上显著优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 动态物体操作对于在真实世界环境中工作的机器人至关重要，然而生成高质量示范的方法仍然有限。为静态任务设计的方法难以直接迁移到动态场景中。在现有的动态示范生成方法中，基于规划的方法在接触附近可能失效，而DOMINO风格的回放方法简化了动态交互，可能限制策略学习可获得的经验。我们提出了DynaForge，一种规划引导的框架，用于学习动态操作示范生成的残差修正。DynaForge结合了低频全局规划与跨任务阶段的高频物体中心逆运动学，并应用残差策略在动态交互过程中修正动作。一种隐式课程在匹配条件下对回合进行分组，并选择混合成功组，将残差强化学习聚焦于不断演进的能力边界上。在Can和Bottle任务中，在相同的标称环境步数预算下，DynaForge使用的优化器步数仅为vanilla GRPO的0.73倍，同时取得了更高的最终成功率。在九个仿真任务中，DynaForge将示范生成的平均成功率从规划先验的41.30%提升至78.37%。每个任务使用800个示范时，基于DynaForge数据训练的DP3策略达到49.11%的平均成功率，而基于DOMINO数据的策略仅为7.07%。在三个真实世界动态任务中，DynaForge训练的策略达到30-60%的成功率，而DOMINO训练的策略仅为0-10%，展示了DynaForge在仿真到现实迁移中的能力。

title: Relative Contact Velocity-Controlled Hand-Object Mechanism for Dexterous Tool Manipulation
summary: This work investigates how to enable general multi-finger robotic hands to perform the complete tool manipulation process, which entails picking up a tool, loading it into a suitable pose, and then wielding it. Inspired by human tool manipulation and mechanical design principles, we model the hand and the tool as a unified hand-object mechanism (HOM) composed of sub-assemblies. Specifically, we define a HOM as consisting of the hand, the object, and the generalized contact frames, allowing the HOM's motions to be expressed with the same set of Cartesian-space relative contact velocities, irrespective of the hand's kinematics and geometry. Then, we define a HOM's sub-assemblies as relative contact velocity and contact force constraints between fingers. Building on these definitions, we developed a lightweight and physically interpretable motion planning and contact estimation framework using least squares and a complementary filter. We evaluated our framework in simulation by teleoperating five different robotic hands. The results show that our framework enabled all five hands to execute the complete tool manipulation process, achieving dexterous behaviors even from identical, simple reference trajectories. Furthermore, the results showcase our framework's adaptability to different hands, tools, and tasks, enabled by its kinematic and geometric foundation.
tldr: This paper proposes a unified hand-object mechanism (HOM) framework that uses relative contact velocities and contact force constraints to enable dexterous tool manipulation across multiple multifingered robotic hands, validated via teleoperation in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种统一的手-物机制（HOM）框架，利用相对接触速度与接触力约束，使多种多指机械手能够完成灵巧的工具操作，并在仿真中通过遥操作验证。
summary_zh: 本工作旨在研究如何使通用多指机器人手完成完整的工具操作过程，包括拾取工具、将其调整至合适的姿态，然后进行挥舞操作。受人类工具操作及机械设计原理的启发，我们将手与工具建模为一个由子装配体组成的统一手-物机构（HOM）。具体而言，我们将HOM定义为由手、物体及广义接触坐标系组成，从而使HOM的运动能够以同一组笛卡尔空间相对接触速度表达，不受手部运动学与几何结构的影响。在此基础上，我们将HOM的子装配体定义为手指之间的相对接触速度与接触力约束。基于上述定义，我们开发了一种轻量级且具有物理可解释性的运动规划与接触估计框架，采用最小二乘法与互补滤波器实现。我们在仿真环境中通过遥操作五种不同的机器人手对该框架进行了评估。结果表明，该框架使所有五种手均能完成完整的工具操作过程，即使在相同且简单的参考轨迹下也能实现灵巧的操作行为。此外，结果还展示了该框架在不同手型、工具及任务中的适应能力，这得益于其基于运动学与几何结构的基础设计。

title: A Deployable Four-Finger Payload for Teleoperated Free-Flying Manipulation with Astrobee
summary: This article presents a bimanual teleoperation pipeline and conceptual design of a deployable four-finger payload for intra-vehicular free-flyers. Future habitats in low-Earth orbit (LEO) will require systems to perform mundane tasks like cargo handling and maintenance during crewed and uncrewed periods. The gripper payload provides 17 manipulation degrees-of-freedom (DoF) through four independently actuated fingers on a linear rail system. To control it, a virtual reality (VR) device interface maps the human ground operator's hand motions to the finger pairs, their separation to the rail, and common wrist motion to Astrobee translation. We present the preliminary results of teleoperating Astrobee in a custom zero-gravity MuJoCo-based International Space Station (ISS) simulator through ten repeated trials of transporting a rigid ISS Cargo Transfer Bag (CTB). We measure task success, continuous contact retention, completion time, and cargo motion.
tldr: This paper presents a bimanual teleoperation pipeline and a deployable four-finger gripper payload for Astrobee free-flyers, demonstrating teleoperated cargo transport in a zero-gravity MuJoCo ISS simulator. The system uses a VR interface to map human hand motions to the gripper and Astrobee translation, with preliminary results from ten repeated trials measuring task success, contact retention, completion time, and cargo motion.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了用于Astrobee自由飞行器的双手机器人遥操作流程和可部署四指夹持器载荷，并在零重力MuJoCo国际空间站模拟器中演示了遥操作货物运输。该系统使用VR界面将人类手部动作映射到夹持器和Astrobee平移，并通过十次重复试验初步评估了任务成功率、接触保持、完成时间和货物运动。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种双臂遥操作流水线及一款可展开四指载荷的概念设计，该载荷适用于舱内自由飞行器。未来近地轨道（LEO）中的居住设施将需要系统在载人及无人期间执行货物搬运、维护等常规任务。该抓取器载荷通过线性滑轨系统上的四个独立驱动手指提供17个操作自由度（DoF）。为对其进行控制，虚拟现实（VR）设备接口将地面操作员的手部动作映射至手指对，手指间的间距映射至滑轨，而腕部的常见运动则映射至Astrobee的平移。我们展示了在基于MuJoCo的自定义零重力国际空间站（ISS）模拟器中，通过十次重复搬运刚性ISS货物转运袋（CTB）的任务，对Astrobee进行遥操作的初步结果。我们测量了任务成功率、连续接触保持能力、完成时间及货物运动情况。

title: Digital Twin-Driven VR Teleoperation with Multi-View Spatial Perception for Surgical Robots
summary: Current robot-assisted minimally-invasive surgery (RMIS) platforms provide a fixed console for the surgeon to view stereo endoscopic images and teleoperate instruments inside the patient. Several researchers have proposed the use of a head-mounted display (HMD) as a portable console, with video pass-through rendering of the endoscope images which, like the fixed console, restricts the operator to a single endoscopic viewpoint and limits depth perception. We present a digital twin-driven virtual reality (VR) teleoperation platform, where the digital twin is created from markerless perception of the surgical environment and streamed for display on the HMD. This overcomes the limitations of video pass-through by providing multi-view rendering and natural motion-parallax cues, enabling decoupling of the user's hand posture from strict instrument alignment. The system utilizes VR hand controllers to increase the teleoperation workspace and to improve the robustness and stability of instrument control compared to the hand tracking approach adopted by most prior systems. A 15-participant user study on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) shows that our VR platform significantly outperforms a state-of-the-art HoloLens 2 mixed reality baseline, reducing path length by 86% and jerk by 95%, while achieving depth perception confidence comparable to or exceeding the traditional console across all conditions.
tldr: This paper presents a digital twin-driven VR teleoperation platform for surgical robots, using HMD-based multi-view rendering and decoupled hand control to improve depth perception and instrument stability compared to mixed reality baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于手术机器人的数字孪生驱动的VR遥操作平台，利用头戴式显示器的多视角渲染和手部姿态解耦控制，相比混合现实基线显著改善了深度感知和器械操控稳定性。
summary_zh: 当前的手术机器人辅助微创手术（RMIS）平台为外科医生提供了固定控制台，用于观看立体内窥镜图像并操控患者体内的器械。部分研究者提出将头戴式显示器（HMD）作为便携式控制台，通过视频透视技术渲染内窥镜图像，但与传统固定控制台类似，这种方案仍将操作者限制于单一内窥镜视角，并影响深度感知。我们提出了一种由数字孪生驱动的虚拟现实（VR）遥操作平台，其中数字孪生基于对手术环境的无标记感知构建，并流式传输至HMD进行显示。该平台通过提供多视角渲染和自然的运动视差线索，突破了视频透视技术的局限，实现用户手部姿态与器械严格对齐的解耦。系统采用VR手部控制器，相比现有大多数系统所采用的手部追踪方法，扩大了遥操作工作空间，并提升了器械控制的稳健性和稳定性。在达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上进行的15名参与者用户研究表明，我们的VR平台显著优于先进的HoloLens 2混合现实基线系统，路径长度减少了86%，加速度变化率（jerk）降低了95%，同时在各条件下，其深度感知置信度达到甚至超过传统控制台的水平。

title: RoboMP-DINOv2: Prompts, Not Filters for Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot manipulation policies must generalize across visual shifts while preserving scene context relevant to action.
